title: Agent Evaluation Lab trace failure handling follow-up
objective: Ensure failed LocalTrace persistence is never presented as a saved trace, and prove backend/UI failure handling against the current repository state without changing the frozen Evaluation Lab contract.

work_items.title: Add backend coverage for LocalTrace persistence failure
deliverables: A deterministic API test proving an unsaved LocalTrace fails the declared trace check and persists a truthful run result.
done_when: Test uses temporary SQLite and a local filesystem failure fixture
No provider/network call or job is created
Test distinguishes a provisional trace ID from a saved trace

work_items.title: Render unsaved traces and provider run errors honestly
deliverables: UI state rendering that shows failed local trace persistence as not saved, plus rendered error-result coverage.
done_when: A provisional trace ID is not rendered as persisted when trace_state is local_trace_failed
Saved local trace IDs and confirmed Jaeger links remain identity-bound
A provider error result is visibly distinct from a deterministic assertion failure
Tests cover failure and normal states
No provider call occurs before explicit Run

work_items.title: Make the frontend API tests use declared tooling
deliverables: A reproducible API-client UI test that uses the declared TypeScript compiler rather than undeclared esbuild.
done_when: No new package or network dependency is introduced
The client test retains the same API assertions
Frontend UI test command can execute after the fix

work_items.title: Verify follow-up and materialize updated product status
deliverables: Focused verification bound to the observed HEAD; accurate goal status and remaining blockers.
done_when: Focused backend and frontend suites and frontend build are executed with exact outcomes
Relevant product criteria are mapped to evidence and limits
Product remains PARTIAL/EXECUTED unless current verification proves every criterion
No cloud call, commit, push, merge or deployment
